cands.bio: Democrat from Greensboro, Alabama. Holds a B.S. from Alabama State University and a J.D. from Miles Law School. Listed as a business owner and consultant. Served in the Alabama House (District 72) 2002–2005, then in the Alabama Senate (District 24) from 2005. Senate Minority Leader since December 2018.

controversies.text: In April 2008, a Country Crossing gambling project representative claimed Singleton, then chair of the Senate Tourism and Marketing Committee, agreed to hold a bill in committee for $25,000. The bill would have denied electronic bingo funds to the project. Singleton denied having any contact with the project's representatives. No court or official finding is reported.

cands.gaps: We found no bills he sponsored, no specific actions in office and no stated positions on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, growth and land protection, immigration and H-1B, police funding, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys in 2022 or 2026. We found no documented public stance on data centers or development. We could not confirm where he grew up or when he may have moved within Alabama. We found no foreign ties and no endorsements beyond a minor voter-guide listing.
